title: Traveller's Chest
summary: Send items to a storage chest that follows your party from camp to camp.

fields.Storage: Use Send to Camp from an inventory context menu. Items persist between campsites. The Long Rest menu can use stored Camp Supplies. Certain quest items can be accessed when needed.
fields.Gold and multiplayer: Stored gold is usable for some trades and dialogue. The pinned source reports console support was missing through Patch 7 Hotfix 29. Multiplayer players have separate chests.
fields.Base value: No nominal BG3 value is listed in the pinned source.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
